attributes.mlflow.spanInputs: {"question": "Can I change the email address my invoices go to?"}
attributes.mlflow.spanOutputs:
"I don't have a documented procedure for changing the invoice email address in the quick facts, so I'll answer from what a SaaS provider like Acme typically offers.

You can usually change the billing or invoice email from your account's billing settings. Go to Settings → Billing (or Billing → Billing contact), edit the billing email, and save. The change applies to future invoices, and past invoices stay with the address they were sent to. If your account is on an invoiced or enterprise plan, the billing contact may need to be updated by an account admin, and you may need to confirm the change by clicking a link sent to the new address.

If you tell me which plan you're on and whether you're an account admin, I can give you more specific steps."
